title: HDCD-materials: Holographic droplet collision detection
description: HDCD stands for Holographic droplet collision detection. These evaluation data, trained models and code accompany Semi-automated detection of droplet collision-coalescence using digital in-line holography. Supports all three pretrained models on the complete independent test seed 260745, Tables 3–4, and Figures 4, 5, 7, 8 and 11–15. Includes 3D test trajectories, compact candidate and image measurements, numerical figure inputs and the 1,120-row top-80 experimental review cohort. Preparation calculates trajectory features and test particle states locally and verifies reference checksums. Five-seed training data, supplementary evaluations, full experimental sequence replay, raw images and upstream particle-measurement weights are outside this distribution. Numerical research data use CC BY 4.0; software and included collision-model weights use MIT. See the README for installation and commands.
